story.summaryEn:
Our partnership with @cohere is built on a shared ambition to push the boundaries of what's possible.
By unlocking knowledge through enterprise AI, we're empowering our teams to make better decisions and focus on higher-value work, in an environment where every second counts - every second of the day.
detailZh:
阿斯顿·马丁与Cohere合作，共同推动可能性的边界。
通过企业AI解锁知识，我们正在赋予我们的团队更好的决策能力，并专注于高价值工作，在一个每一秒都至关重要的环境中 - 每一天的每一秒。
